product.name: sessionspec
product.lede: sessionspec lifts the transcripts of an agent harness into one specified IR of actors, commands, decisions and events, redacts it, stores it in a local SQLite file, and evaluates KPIs, sq queries and mined patterns on that store. It reads Claude Code transcripts today; an LLM gateway appends the same records from the wire. There is no release yet: build it from source.
product.description: Lift agent sessions into one specified IR, store them in SQLite, and evaluate KPIs, queries and mined patterns over them. Reads Claude Code transcripts; no release yet.
product.meta: No release yet · Claude Code transcripts · Apache-2.0

sections.title: From a transcript to a number.
sections.lede: KPIs read the events the generated component published, never a vendor transcript.

steps.label: lift
steps.title: Transcript to commands
steps.description: An adapter turns each record into IR commands with an actor and an attribution: Known, Inferred or NotRecorded.

steps.label: redact
steps.title: Classes and counts
steps.description: Secrets and personal data become aliases; a finding names its class and count, never the value.

steps.label: store
steps.title: One SQLite file
steps.description: sessionspec sync lifts new and changed sessions into a local store, incrementally.

steps.label: evaluate
steps.title: KPIs, queries, patterns
steps.description: KPIs, sq checks and mined patterns run over the store, not over the transcript files.

sections.title: What the repository holds.
sections.lede: Each item links to the page that describes it.

items.title: Session IR
items.description: An ESS specification of actors, commands, decisions, events and views, with generated types and components.

items.title: sq
items.description: A typed Datalog over the IR with sequence, aggregates and certainty, and checks in queries/session.sq.

items.title: Dashboard
items.description: sessionspec serve: a local UI on 127.0.0.1 with global KPIs, a time window, the recent sessions and search.

items.title: Records library
items.description: sessionspec-records: the store, the wire lift of a gateway call and a non-blocking appender.
